description:
Add garden objects (one or more) in one call. Type determines rendering: 'plant' for plants, 'building' for architecture, 'rectangle'/'ellipse'/'polygon'/'path' for ground shapes, 'shape' for a generic plant shape; a path takes pathWaypoints (centreline) and pathWidth. Each object takes productId OR productQuery (a name search resolved server-side) — a shape takes `shape` instead, sized by width (spread or length), height (depth across) and `tall`; a hedge shape can take `line`. Width/height are optional (catalog defaults; a shape's middle size). Returns `ids` in input order (null where one failed) and `issues` for failures and warnings.

Generic plant shapes stand for no species, only a form (SC-191): trees tree_round/oval/conical/columnar/weeping/spreading (2–25 m tall); shrubs shrub_round/conical/columnar/upright/spreading (0.2–6 m); clump = a drift of perennials or grasses (0.15–2.5 m tall, width = the drift's diameter); groundcover = a low mat (≤ 0.5 m, width = its diameter: 1, 2 or 4 m); hedge = a line (0.3–4 m tall, 0.3–2 m thick); climber = a panel on a wall or fence. Sizes are mature, in metres; a size outside the form's range is set to its edge and the reply says so; with no size, the form's middle size.

elevation.description: Ground surfaces only: how high the surface is raised, in metres (a deck, a raised strip of soil). Architecture — raised beds, planters, furniture — always stands at its catalog height, as its model is drawn, and plants in it stand on that; a value given for it is ignored (choose a taller product instead). Not the footprint: that is width × height.

height.description: Footprint size north–south (plan depth, not how tall it is), m; optional, defaults to product catalog value. Ignored for plants (mature catalog size). A shape: its depth across (a hedge's thickness, an oval mat's other diameter).

line.description: type=shape, a hedge: [[x1, y1], [x2, y2]] in metres, end to end — sets x, y, width (its length) and rotation

notes.description: type=shape: what the species must bring, for the swap later (evergreen, flowers, sun or shade); a species the designer named goes in the label

path.description: Surface corridor as an ABSOLUTE centreline in metres plus width (for type=path), exactly as add_zones takes it. Preferred over pathWaypoints/pathWidth.

pathWaypoints.description: Centerline waypoints (for type=path), RELATIVE to the object's centre x/y — use `path` (absolute) instead. At least 2 points required.

pathWidth.description: Path corridor width, m; for type=path, default 1m

points.description: Polygon vertices (for type=polygon), RELATIVE to the object's centre x/y — use `polygon` (absolute) instead unless you have centre-relative points

polygon.description: Surface outline as ABSOLUTE vertices in metres (for type=polygon), exactly as add_zones takes it — e.g. a zone's outline from get_zones. Preferred over points; x/y/width/height are then computed.

productId.description: Product ID from the catalog (use this OR productQuery)

productQuery.description: Product name search query — resolved server-side. If ambiguous, returns error with top candidates. Use this OR productId.

tall.description: type=shape: how tall it grows, m (a crown given only its width keeps its proportions)

type.description: Object type; `shape` = a generic plant shape (no product): give `shape`, not productId

width.description: Footprint size east–west, m; optional, defaults to product catalog value. Ignored for plants: they are drawn at their mature catalog size and cannot be resized. A shape: its spread, or a hedge's or climber's length.

zoneId.description: Optional zone ID — if provided, validates that the object center falls within the zone boundary. Returns warning if outside. Placement always succeeds.

name: add_objects
